description: Schedule a saved ContentRipple variant (its text plus hashtags) to a connected account of the matching platform at a given time. Only these formats can be published: twitter_thread, linkedin_post, linkedin_carousel, instagram_caption, instagram_reel_script, threads_post, mastodon_post, bluesky_post — the rest are copy-only. This queues real content for a real audience; confirm the text, account and time with the user first.

connected_account_id.description: Connected account UUID on the variant's platform — from list_connections.

post_batch_id.description: Optional UUID shared with sibling posts of the same content, for managing them together.

name: schedule_content_variant
